scope.note: Two broad index queries with direct primary localization and primary reference follow-up. Finite top15 coverage cannot establish absence.

Guo2017.title: On Calibration of Modern Neural Networks
Guo2017.formula: softmax(W z + b); vector scaling constrains W diagonal; parameters optimize held-out NLL while NN parameters fixed
Guo2017.match: Candidate bias-only is W=I, a constrained existing calibrator family; reading did not find the exact count-prior quadratic anchor

BCTS2020.title: Maximum Likelihood with Bias-Corrected Calibration is Hard-To-Beat at Label Shift Adaptation
BCTS2020.formula: BCTS is temperature scaling with additional class-specific bias terms; NLL optimized on validation set, equivalent softmax(z/T+b)
BCTS2020.match: z+b is T=1 restriction, so class-bias adaptation / no NN retraining / logit-only calibration are existing atoms
BCTS2020.distinction: Not federated local TRAIN fitting with count-prior L2 anchor. Its separate EM concavity theorem concerns target-prior maximum likelihood, not a novelty theorem for this candidate objective.

FedCal2024.title: FedCal: Achieving Local and Global Calibration in Federated Learning via Aggregated Parameterized Scaler
FedCal2024.formula: order-preserving MLP takes frozen current model logits; local NLL scaler training, weight matching and aggregation; default K-64-64-K
FedCal2024.match: explicit personalized/local posthoc calibration in FL and global scaler aggregation
FedCal2024.distinction: learned MLP and scaler communication with periodic synchronization, not 10dim pure local retained prior-anchored intercept; maintaining original ordering pursues confidence calibration rather than candidate ability to alter class decisions

PrivateFederated2025.title: Private Federated Multiclass Post-hoc Calibration
PrivateFederated2025.formula: g(z)=softmax(Az+b); FedVector diagonal A; FedMatrix unrestricted; FedTemp inverse temperature and b=0. Local scaler fitted over logits and parameters shared/averaged over rounds. Has train/calibration/test splits. Uses convex local solver for FedTemp/FedOPVector in timing discussion
PrivateFederated2025.match: explicit federated logit calibration including bias vectors; family contains A=I bias-only as mathematical restriction
PrivateFederated2025.distinction: global calibrator through aggregated parameters, no read count-prior anchor / pure local state / low-bit chainauth same combination. Source discusses local skew/global accuracy empirically, not an effectiveness verdict about current personalized candidate. Paper does not establish candidate Newton method novelty.

CCVR2021.title: No Fear of Heterogeneity: Classifier Calibration for Federated Learning with Non-IID Data
CCVR2021.formula: freeze feature extractor, adjust classifier using sampled virtual representations from classwise GMM, requiring feature statistics
CCVR2021.distinction: classifier weight learning with server-side synthetic features, not a fixed-logit ten-bias pure local calibration; secondary neighbor, omitted from concise report

candidate_math_audit.claim_boundary: Convex fixed-logit fitting plus positive quadratic makes a strongly convex problem. Newton is a standard numerical optimizer, not neural backprop, but fitting is still optimization. Once per-example logits are produced they can be cached for all bias iterations; this is an implementation property of fixed-logit calibrators generally.
candidate_math_audit.gauge: Without regularization softmax invariant to adding the same constant to b. Full positive L2 fixes this gauge. Count versus normalized prior differs by a constant and yields equivalent predictions when translated consistently.
candidate_math_audit.Bayes_boundary: logcount anchor is a regularization choice; it is not automatically the correct target/source prior ratio for CE or FedLC raw outputs, and does not imply perfect calibration.
candidate_math_audit.storage: 10 FP32 bias numbers=40B deploy vector; temporary logits O(n_i*C), Hessian O(C^2), counts and source/identity metadata must be accounted separately if retained.

minimum_strong_controls: same-lambda zero-centered L2 bias to isolate anchor, with compatible gauge convention
local BCTS / temperature plus class bias
dense plus same prior-anchored bias to isolate low-bit compression
FedCal literature reference with its greater parameter and communication budget explicit
evaluation_rules: Use same available TRAIN, checkpoint and tuning budget across local fit methods; no external calibration labels for a favored method; compare independent held-out NLL, accuracy and calibration rather than assuming lower fitting NLL proves calibration. Final tuning and independent split/seed remain parent decisions; no experimental recommendation was acted on here.
conclusion: Candidate is a count-prior-anchored, fixed-unit-scale restriction/regularization of established logit-scaling methods, integrated with known low-bit FL and authentication. No exact whole combination located within two top15 query pages and five primary reads. This is not evidence of nonexistence, atom novelty or benefit.
